status_summary: The Trade Adjustment Assistance for Workers program remains terminated: the Labor Department's page says the termination provision of section 285(a) of the Trade Act took effect 2022-07-01, that it may not accept new petitions or issue determinations until further notice, and that only workers certified and separated on or before 2022-06-30 may receive benefits; the page does not mention reauthorization. In the 119th Congress, S. 1449 (introduced 2025-04-10) would extend the program through 2031-12-31 and was referred to the Finance Committee, and H.R. 7805 (introduced 2026-03-04) was referred to Ways and Means; no further action was found. No law or administration action that treats trade-displaced workers the same as other displaced workers, or that converts assistance to cash transfers, was found.

timeline.event: S. 1449, the Trade Adjustment Assistance Reauthorization Act of 2025, was introduced and referred to the Senate Finance Committee.
H.R. 7805, the Trade Adjustment Assistance Modernization Act, was introduced and referred to House Ways and Means.
